description: This Java source file defines the ShippingOptionsController class, which handles HTTP requests related to viewing and saving shipping options in an admin web interface. It is a Spring MVC controller that interacts with shipping service and configuration models, processes form data, and manages the display of shipping settings.

classes.name: ShippingOptionsController
classes.description: Spring MVC Controller managing shipping options display and update in the admin section

methods.name: displayShippingOptions
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display current shipping options, fetches configuration, sets defaults if missing, and formats monetary fields for display

methods.name: saveShippingOptions
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save updated shipping configuration, processes form data, validates prices, and persists configuration

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Sets active menu context and current menu item for the shipping section in the admin UI
